business_summary: HEROZ, Inc. engages in planning, developing, and operating of intellectual games for smartphones by using its artificial intelligence and machine learning technology in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the development of various smartphone apps, such as Shogi Wars, CHESS HEROZ, BackgammonAce, Kishin Analytics, and Kishin Learning. It also provides security business process outsourcing services and integration services; SaaS-related services in the B2B sector, such as RHEROZ ASKJ, QuickSummary2.0, and Al Sakura-san; and support for AI and SaaS implementation and development of inter-SaaS integration. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
